newsitem.title: USA: Springsteen saxophonist arrested on battery charge.
newsitem.headline: Springsteen saxophonist arrested on battery charge.

text.p: Clarence Clemons, the saxophonist for Bruce Springsteen's E Street Band, is scheduled to appear in court on Monday for allegedly beating a woman last month at a home in Isla Morada in the Florida Keys, police said.
Clemons, 49, is being held without bond on domestic battery charges at the West Palm Beach County detention centre following his arrest on Friday night.

Clemons is charged with punching and kicking Sharlene Smalley in a late-night fight that allegedly began on Dec. 6 and resumed in the morning hours of Dec. 7 while the pair vacationed in Isla Morada, said Becky Herrin, a spokeswoman for the Monroe County Sheriff's Department.
Smalley, who reportedly shares a home with Clemons on Singer Island in West Palm Beach County, told police Clemons grabbed her, threw her against the wall, punched and kicked her.
Smalley was treated at Mariners Hospital on Dec. 7.
Herrin said Clemons would be transferred to the jail at Marathon, Florida, on Monday and then may be sent to a jail near Key West.
Herrin said Clemons might appear in court via video and bail would be considered at that time.
